endpoints.description: This document: endpoints, snapshot index, coverage summary, license and the deprecation policy.
Per-day expected vs captured slot counts, every named gap, revision counts, first-seen coverage and pending reaction horizons.
Story ledger re-exported under the frozen path: stable ids, firstSeenAt, sightings, headline revisions, per-wire first-mover ranking.
Theme board heat re-exported under the frozen path: board code/name, board move, advancing/declining counts, article hits, constituents.
News-to-price reaction library (+1h/+1d/+5d). Advertised only once daily_reports/reactions.json exists at build time; omitted entirely until then rather than served empty.

license.data: Code is MIT. Data terms: quotes come from public delayed endpoints of the exchanges' own vendors and are published for reading, at most one publish cycle behind; they are not a licensed real-time feed, are not for order execution, and are not investment advice. Story headlines and links remain the property of their publishers. No third-party licensed dataset is redistributed. If you mirror this data, keep the gaps page visible — a mirror that drops gaps is no longer point-in-time.

deprecation.policy: Within /v1 nothing a consumer sees is removed or retyped. New fields may appear at any time and consumers must ignore unknown ones. A field that must change shape is added alongside the old one, and the old one keeps its exact type until /v1 is retired.
deprecation.breakingChange: A breaking change ships as a new namespace: /v2/<same path>.
deprecation.noticePeriod: After /v2/ publishes, /v1/ keeps being written for at least 12 months and its manifest keeps naming the successor. No silent removal: an endpoint that stops is removed from the manifest in the same build that stops writing it.

promised.text: Every file is static JSON produced at build time from files already in this repository's publish tree.
Every tape value carries asOf (market clock) and observedAt (our fetch clock), both ISO 8601 with an offset.
A missing slot, section or input is named in gaps[] with a stable code — never silently absent.
A re-capture writes <HHMM>.rev-N.json; it never overwrites the base capture's bytes.
Additive-only within v1; a breaking change ships as /v2/.

notPromised.text: No real-time push: no WebSocket, no SSE, no streaming. Everything is a file, refreshed by a build.
No L2 depth or order book — we do not buy, resell or fabricate licensed depth data.
No revision history beyond the published trail (tape/<date>/revisions.jsonl and the .rev-N.json files).
No retroactive archive edits: published slots are not rewritten, and a backfilled edition is labelled as one.
No SLA: a missed tick is a named gap, not a refund.
